name: trail-monorepo
description: Trail: perícia de registros para ServiceNow. Extensão de navegador, somente leitura.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @trail/core && npm run build -w trail-extension
scripts.e2e: node tests/e2e/smoke.mjs && node tests/e2e/content-ui16.mjs && node tests/e2e/content-list.mjs && node tests/e2e/content-portal.mjs && node tests/e2e/content-workspace.mjs && node tests/e2e/prefs-window.mjs && node tests/e2e/float.mjs && node tests/e2e/reload.mjs && node tests/e2e/flows.mjs && node tests/e2e/settings.mjs && node tests/e2e/advanced.mjs
scripts.shots: node tests/e2e/screenshots.mjs light && node tests/e2e/screenshots.mjs dark
